title: A proper morphism that is an isomorphism over a quasi-compact open becomes an isomorphism after an admissible blowup
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: 命题说代数空间之间的 proper 态射若在拟紧开子空间 U 上是同构，则存在 U-可容许的爆炸使严格变换成为同构。证明是三次换条件：先用爆炸把态射化为平坦且有限展示，再（必要时）用爆炸使 U 概型论稠密，于是 proper + 平坦 + 稠密给出有限性，最后由 Zariski 型引理得到开浸入。不能一眼完成的是收尾：要同时用「像闭」与「含稠密开」把开浸入升级为同构。原文位于第 8936–8959 行。
